claim: For Db2, MariaDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL gp3 volumes of 20–399 GiB, the baseline is 3,000 IOPS/125 MiB/s and additional IOPS or throughput can't be provisioned (not applicable).
question: What performance does a small RDS gp3 volume (under 400 GiB) get for MySQL or PostgreSQL?

values.spoken: twenty to three hundred ninety-nine gibibytes
three thousand IOPS and one hundred twenty-five mebibytes per second

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance (gp3; Db2, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
